newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-WEEKEND PROGRAMME IN THE FRENCH LEAGUE CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEEKEND PROGRAMME IN THE FRENCH LEAGUE CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: The following matches are scheduled to take place this weekend in the French league championship (league positions in parentheses, all kickoff times Saturday 1800 GMT unless stated)

Still without stars Enzo Scifo, Marco Grassi and Eric Di Meco, Monaco hope to retain the form which allowed them to beat Borussia Moenchengladbach 4-2 in the UEFA Cup on Tuesday. They are without suspended Ali Benarbia and possibly midfielder Sylvain Legwinski. Nice recover Liberian striker James Debbah for this French Riviera clash.

Lens hope to win at home for the first time since late August. Captain Jean-Guy Wallemme is back from a thigh injury but coach Slavo Muslin must do without suspended Frederic Dehu and injured Cyrille Magnier and Mickael Debeve. Rennes, 3-0 winners at Cannes last week, have no major absentees.

After a disastrous start to the season, 1995 champions Nantes are unbeaten in their last five outings. Without Eddy Capron, Laurent Guyot and Argentine striker Javier Mazzoni, the Canaries need a win. Bordeaux, who have only scored once in their last five matches, are without two key strikers, Argentine Claudio Biaggio and Didier Tholot.

A home defeat against Caen last week started a furore in Marseille and coach Gerard Gili warned stars Iordan Lechkov and Reynald Pedros they faced sanctions in case of another loss at bottom-placed Nancy. The team from eastern France scored their first victory of the season last week in Bordeaux.

Lyon is without suspended Jean-Christophe Devaux and Ghislain Anselmini for this tricky clash between two of the main outsiders in the title's race. Metz are without injured Brazilian Isaias and suspended Didier Lang.

Montpellier are without eight first choice players to host Lille. But the team form northern France have yet to win a match away from home and are without marksmen Miladin Becanovic and Djezon Boutoille.
Guinghamp are without three of their leading players, international Vincent Candela, Liberia's Christopher Wreh and Romania's Gheorghe Mihali. Le Havre are without defender Djibril Diawara.
Caen have just scored their first victory of the season in Marseille and welcome back gifted playmaker Stephane Roche. Strasbourg can rely on a full squad for the tie.

Held to a goalless draw by Monaco last week, Bastia must replace Slovak playmaker Lubomir Moravick, who is out for the rest of the season with a broken ankle. Cannes have three suspended players, David Jemmali, Romain Ferrier and Mickael Marsiglia.

Top match of the season so far pits shocked PSG against recovering Auxerre. The Parisians are unbeaten in the league but lost 4-2 at Galatasaray in the Cupwinners Cup on Thursday. After a lacklustre start, champions Auxerre are back in contention and beat Grasshopper 1-0 in the Champions league. PSG are still without injured Bernard Lama, Bruno N'Gotty and suspended Alain Roche. Auxerre are without suspended Taribo West and Christian Henna.
